messages.body: Riley, attached is our renewal redline for the support SLA. We need a decision on credit tiers before Friday. Legal asked whether auto-renew stays at twelve months.
Morgan, thanks. We can accept the credit tier if response time stays under four hours. Auto-renew can stay, but we need a ninety-day exit clause. Please confirm procurement can sign next week.
Counter-offer noted. We can do ninety-day exit with a thirty-day notice. Credit tier B is fine if you keep the on-call rotation. Can you send a clean summary for executives?
Summary drafted: exit clause, credit tier B, on-call unchanged. I also removed the audit fee increase for year one. Ready for your approval language.
Approved on our side with one ask: freeze pricing for eighteen months. If that works, we can execute Wednesday. Otherwise escalate to procurement leadership.
Eighteen months is acceptable if volume stays above the current seat count. I will send the final PDF tonight. Please reply with the signing contact.
Signing contact is Priya Nair in procurement. Use the Amsterdam entity details from last year. We still need the careful negotiation reply for the board packet.
Understood. I will prepare the careful negotiation reply once you escalate. Thread history is long enough for a full rewrite. Confirm consent when you are ready to hand this off.
